name: Dreamblu Fantasy - Authenticated Player Experience & Navigation Journey
description: Performs authenticated login with user@example.com, navigates to the Player Profile, validates account credentials & verification status, tests Inventory and Shop views, and records visual traces on http://localhost:7777.

steps.description: 1. Open Dreamblu Fantasy Database
2. Verify Guest Login / Sign In button is present
3. Click Guest Login button to trigger login modal
4. Wait for authentication email field
5. Enter player email: user@example.com
6. Enter player password: Password123
7. Click 'SIGN IN TO ACCOUNT' to authenticate
8. Wait for session state to refresh and display 'Lucio ▾'
9. Verify player identity badge is rendered
10. Navigate to Player Profile (/profile)
11. Wait for Profile Header to load
12. Assert Profile header text: 'PLAYER PROFILE & ACCOUNT'
13. Assert account status is VERIFIED
14. Assert display name Lucio is displayed on profile

steps.name: dreamblu-profile-view
steps.description: 15. Capture screenshot of verified player profile
16. Navigate to Player Inventory (/inventory)
17. Allow inventory grid to populate
18. Assert zero horizontal bleed on inventory page

steps.name: dreamblu-inventory-view
steps.description: 19. Capture screenshot of inventory interface
20. Navigate to In-Game Shop (/shop)
21. Allow shop catalog items to load
22. Assert zero horizontal bleed in shop

steps.name: dreamblu-shop-view
steps.description: 23. Capture screenshot of shop interface
24. Return to home dashboard
25. Assert player session remains persistently authenticated on homepage
26. Verify topbar has no text clipping

steps.name: dreamblu-persisted-session-return
steps.description: 27. Capture final evidence of persistent authenticated session
